evidence_ladder.name: Deep search becomes eligible
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: The crew may begin dedicated biosignature and technosignature searches.

evidence_ladder.name: Candidate anomaly
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: An observation is unusual; natural, instrumental, and data-processing explanations remain open.

evidence_ladder.name: Replicated anomaly
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: The anomaly repeats or appears in an independent channel; artificial origin is still unconfirmed.

evidence_ladder.name: Major alternatives constrained
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: Several ordinary explanations are weakened, but unconceived alternatives remain possible.

evidence_ladder.name: Technological origin becomes plausible
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: A technological explanation is scientifically discussable, not confirmed.

evidence_ladder.name: Information-bearing structure
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: Non-random structure survives independent analysis; agency and origin remain under review.

evidence_ladder.name: External technology confirmed
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: Evidence supports non-human technological origin; living creators are not automatically implied.

evidence_ladder.name: External agency confirmed
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: A responsive or contemporaneous external intelligence is supported by multiple independent evidence chains.

evidence_ladder.name: Interaction phase
evidence_ladder.claim_ceiling: Communication or physical interaction is occurring; intent and consequences remain uncertain.

hypothesis_families.use: Expose uncertain factors controlling the prevalence of detectable civilizations.
hypothesis_families.not_allowed: Treating one chosen parameter set as a measured count.

hypothesis_families.use: Compare expansion, longevity, detectability, distance, and search coverage against the observed lack of confirmed contact.
hypothesis_families.not_allowed: Treating silence as proof that no extraterrestrial life exists.

hypothesis_families.use: Explore what follows when Earth-like evolutionary timing is treated as typical or atypical.
hypothesis_families.not_allowed: Calling the model output a census.

hypothesis_families.use: Model bottlenecks between habitability, life, intelligence, technology, longevity, and detectability.
hypothesis_families.not_allowed: Selecting a specific filter without evidence.

hypothesis_families.use: Explore whether microbial life can be common while complex or technological life remains rare.
Model the delay between a civilization becoming detectable and another civilization being able to notice and respond.
hypothesis_families.not_allowed: Guaranteeing contact after a fixed age.

hypothesis_families.use: Explore expanding technological populations, visible domains, and observation selection effects.
hypothesis_families.not_allowed: Treating unseen expanding civilizations as established entities.

hypothesis_families.use: Test whether coordinated concealment is causally and sociologically feasible.
hypothesis_families.not_allowed: Using non-detection as positive evidence of deliberate concealment.
Entering the scientific probability model or pre-labelling unknown agents as hostile.
